name: sdd
description: Reusable Spec-Driven Development workflows from repository bootstrap through validated incremental implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare, specify, plan, test, and implement changes.
interface.longDescription: Reusable Spec-Driven Development workflows for repository preparation, requirements, review, architecture, decisions, planning, test design, and incremental implementation.
defaultPrompt: Use $project-bootstrap to prepare this repository for the SDD workflow.
Use $spec-author to prepare an implementation-ready specification.
Use $spec-reviewer to assess whether this specification is implementation-ready.
Use $architecture-designer to design a traceable architecture from this specification.
Use $adr-author to clarify an architectural decision and record it with the appropriate status.
Use $implementation-planner to turn confirmed specifications and designs into a traceable implementation plan.
Use $test-designer to derive a traceable test strategy from requirements, decisions, and implementation plans.
Use $implementation to execute a validated SDD plan incrementally with continuous verification.
